content.text:
Validated. Your premise is **wrong** — good you asked me to check.

## What `--json` actually is

Not a root-global flag. It's a **persistent** flag registered by `addControlPlaneFlags()` (`corecmd.go:29`) on **4 control-plane group roots**: `repo` (repo.go:25), `org` (org.go:19), `project` (project.go:19), `grant` (grant.go:58). Persistent → inherited by every subcommand under those groups.

## Where it's actually implemented (honored)

Broadly, **not** just `mirror list`. Every read/list/mutation verb routing through `runCoreList` / `runCoreObject` / `runCoreMutation` honors it via `jsonRequested()`:

- **repo**: `create`, `list`, `get`, `visibility get`, `visibility set`, `mirror list`, `mirror get`, `mirror collaborators list`
- **org / project / grant**: their `create` / `list` / `get` verbs too

Confirmed the full leak set and hit a real cobra constraint that makes your chosen option not cleanly doable. Surfacing before I code.

## Full leak set (9 commands inherit persistent `--json`, none honor it)

- **repo**: `clone`, `delete`, `mirror create`, `mirror remove`
- **org**: `delete`
- **project**: `delete`
- **grant**: `org remove`, `project remove`, `repo remove`

All are side-effect verbs with bespoke/✓-line output — none route through the `runCore*` JSON path.

## The snag with "keep persistent, hide from these 9"

Cobra persistent flag = **one shared `*Flag` pointer** inherited by every child. `MarkHidden` flips that shared pointer → hides it *everywhere* or nowhere. There is no clean per-child hide. To literally "keep persistent but hide on 9 commands" I'd have to shadow it with a local hidden `--json` + a `PreRunE` reject on each of the 9 — a hack in 9 places, and the flag is still silently accepted (just hidden).

## Recommendation — the clean structural fix

The persistent registration *is* the bug. Drop `--json` from `addControlPlaneFlags`; add a one-line `addJSONFlag(cmd)` helper and call it only on the ~15 commands that honor it. Result:
- `--json` on the 9 non-honoring commands → cobra errors `unknown flag: --json` (loud, not silent).
- Help advertises `--json` only where it works — no shadowing, no per-command reject logic.
- `jsonRequested()` unchanged; honoring commands behave identically.

This is essentially the "per-command local flag, all 4 groups" option — which I now see is the *only* clean way, because cobra can't do selective per-child hiding of a persistent flag.

## Why
`--json` was registered as a **persistent** flag on the `repo`/`org`/`project`/`grant`
group roots, so every subcommand inherited it — including side-effect verbs
(`delete`, `clone`, `mirror create/remove`, `grant remove`) that never render a
wire payload and **silently accepted `--json` as a no-op**. Help advertised the
flag on commands that ignored it.

Cobra can't hide a persistent flag from a subset of children, so the fix is
structural: register `--json` locally on exactly the commands that honor it.

## What changed
- Dropped `--json` from persistent `addControlPlaneFlags`; kept
  `--insecure-http-auth` persistent (all commands build a client).
- Added `addJSONFlag(cmd)` helper; wired onto the **20 commands** that render via
  the `runCore*` helpers (list/get/create/mutation verbs).
- `jsonRequested()` unchanged.

## Result
- `entire repo clone --json` → `Error: Invalid usage: unknown flag: --json`
  (loud, no longer a silent no-op).
- `repo clone --help` no longer lists `--json`; `repo mirror list --help` still does.
- Honoring commands behave identically.

## Test plan
- New `TestControlPlaneJSONFlag_OnlyOnHonoringCommands` walks all 4 group trees and
  locks the full command→`--json` matrix (drift in either direction fails).
- `cmd/entire/cli` package tests pass; `golangci-lint` v2.11.3 clean.
- Live binary confirms the reject + help behavior above.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
EOF
)" 2>&1 | tail -5
